title: Booking & Cancellation Policy
body:
At TripNaari, we maintain complete transparency in our booking and cancellation process. By confirming a booking, the traveller agrees to the following terms:

Booking Policy

Domestic Trips
Booking amount: ₹10,000 per traveller
Balance payment: 10 days before departure

International Trips
Booking amount: ₹15,000 per traveller
Balance payment: 15 days before departure

Failure to pay the full balance within the above timeline will be treated as an automatic cancellation, and no refund, transfer, or credit note will be applicable.

Travellers who do not join the trip on the departure date (No-Show) will not be eligible for any refund or credit note.

Cancellation Policy

30 Days or More Before Departure
A credit note equivalent to the booking amount paid will be issued for future travel with TripNaari. Any amount paid over and above the booking amount will be refunded to the original payment source.

Between 30 and 15 Days Before Departure
The booking amount is non-refundable and will be treated as the cancellation charge. The remaining amount paid will be issued as a TripNaari credit note.

Less Than 15 Days Before Departure
No refund, transfer, or credit note will be issued, as hotels, transport, permits, and other services are prepaid and non-recoverable.

Additional Terms

.Refunds, wherever applicable, will be processed within 7–10 working days from cancellation confirmation.
.If TripNaari cancels a trip due to low group size, operational reasons, or adverse weather, travellers will receive either a 100% refund or a full credit note for future travel.
.In case of natural calamities, extreme weather, political unrest, government travel restrictions, airline disruptions, visa restrictions, or other force majeure situations, the amount paid will be issued as a credit note for future travel.
.Credit notes are issued in the name of the original traveller, are non-transferable, non-cash, and subject to availability.
.Any non-refundable components such as permits, safari bookings, event tickets, entry fees, visa fees, airfare components, or special activity charges may be additionally deducted wherever applicable.
.Cancellation requests are valid only when submitted in writing through email or WhatsApp.

By making a booking payment, the traveller confirms that they have read, understood, and accepted this Booking, Cancellation & Refund Policy.

title: Safety Promise & Accountability
body:
At TripNaari, safety is not a feature—it is the foundation of every journey we curate for women travellers. From the moment you book until you return home, our team works to ensure that you travel with confidence, comfort, and support.

Verified Woman Trip Leader on Every Departure

Every TripNaari departure is accompanied by a verified woman trip leader who:

Stays in the same property as the group.
Travels in the same vehicle throughout the trip.
Is trained in CPR and basic first aid.
Carries a first-aid kit on all trips.
Carries an oxygen cylinder on Himalayan departures where altitude support may be required.
Maintains access to an emergency contingency fund for urgent situations.
Verified Hotels, Drivers & Vehicles

All hotels, homestays, drivers, vehicles, and trip leaders undergo a verification process before being assigned to any TripNaari departure.

Hotel Safety Verification

We work only with properties that are reviewed for:

Secure door locks and room safety
Safe neighbourhood and accessibility
Positive reviews from solo women travellers
Hygiene and emergency preparedness
Women-only floors or wings wherever possible
Driver & Vehicle Verification
Drivers are police verified and undergo background checks.
Minimum 5 years of hill-driving experience for mountain destinations.
Vehicles are checked for registration, permits, insurance, and fitness compliance.
No night driving is undertaken without prior group consent and safety assessment.
Homestay Standards

Where homestays are used, preference is given to women-run or family-run properties with trusted local references and community accountability.

Emergency Preparedness

Our trip leaders and drivers always carry a ready emergency contact kit, including:

Nearest hospital details
Nearest police station details
Ambulance and emergency service numbers
Local ground-support contacts
TripNaari operations helpline

This ensures immediate assistance without relying on last-minute online searches.

Emergency Card for Every Traveller

Each traveller receives a printed and WhatsApp emergency card containing:

Trip leader phone number
TripNaari operations helpline (24×7)
Local police station contact
Nearest hospital contact
Founder escalation contact
Communication & Live Support
A dedicated WhatsApp group is created 48 hours before departure.
Live location updates are shared on travel days whenever network permits.
Trip leaders remain actively available from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
Emergency support is available 24×7 through the TripNaari operations team.
Feedback & Safety Escalation

We believe every concern deserves prompt attention.

Level 1: Trip Leader (immediate on-ground resolution)
Level 2: TripNaari Operations 24×7 – +91 92827 94457
Level 3: Founder Escalation – founder@tripnaari.com (response within 24 hours)

Key safety learnings and improvements are reviewed regularly and shared transparently with our community.

Zero-Tolerance Policy

TripNaari has zero tolerance for:

Harassment or intimidation
Non-consensual behaviour
Discrimination or abuse
Hidden costs
Bait-and-switch accommodations
Unsafe conduct by partners, drivers, staff, or travellers

Immediate corrective action will be taken, including partner removal, traveller removal, refunds where appropriate, and formal escalation when required.

You should never have to choose between adventure and safety. With TripNaari, you travel with a verified support system, trained leaders, trusted local partners, and a community that looks out for one another—every step of the journey. 💜

title: Privacy Policy - Your Data, Your Sisterhood
body:
At TripNaari, your privacy and trust are extremely important to us. We collect only the information necessary to plan and deliver a safe, smooth, and personalized travel experience.

What We Collect

We may collect your name, email address, phone number, emergency contact details, and travel preferences when you enquire about or book a trip with us.

How We Protect Your Data

Your information is securely stored in our PostgreSQL database with encryption at rest and protected through industry-standard security practices. Access is limited to authorized team members who need the information to provide travel services.

How We Use Your Phone Number

We use your phone number only for trip-related communication, such as booking confirmations, itinerary updates, departure reminders, and WhatsApp group coordination for your trip. We do not send promotional or marketing messages unless you have explicitly opted in.

We Never Sell Your Data

TripNaari does not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to any third party. Your data is used solely for operating our travel services and supporting your travel experience.

Newsletter & Marketing

If you choose to subscribe to our newsletter, you may unsubscribe at any time by clicking the unsubscribe link in the email or by contacting us directly.

Cookies & Analytics

Our website uses cookies for anonymized analytics and conversion tracking to help us improve our website and understand which pages are useful to visitors. We do not engage in invasive cross-site tracking or build advertising profiles across other websites.

Community Photos & DMCA

Photos shared within the TripNaari community are used only with the consent of the individuals involved. If your photograph appears on our website or social media and you would like it removed, please email us and we will promptly review your request.

Contact Us

For any questions regarding privacy, data protection, or content removal requests, please contact:

TripNaari
Email: info@tripnaari.com
Assam, India

title: Terms & Conditions
body:
Welcome to TripNaari. By booking a trip with us, you agree to the following terms and conditions:

1. Eligibility
Travellers must be 18 years or older to book independently.
Participants below 18 years may travel only with the consent of a parent or legal guardian. For girls aged 12 years and above, written guardian consent may be required before confirmation.

2. Traveller Code of Conduct
All travellers are expected to:

Respect local culture, traditions, and community guidelines.
Maintain courteous behaviour toward fellow travellers, hosts, guides, and staff.
Refrain from the use of illegal drugs, intoxicating substances, harassment, abuse, discrimination, or any unsafe conduct.

TripNaari reserves the right to remove any participant whose behaviour threatens the safety, comfort, or well-being of others, without refund.

3. Changes Due to Safety & Operational Reasons
TripNaari may modify the itinerary, accommodation, transportation, or activities due to weather conditions, road closures, government restrictions, safety concerns, or operational requirements. Wherever possible, travellers will be informed at least 12 hours in advance.

4. Force Majeure
TripNaari shall not be held liable for delays, cancellations, losses, or disruptions caused by events beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to:

Severe weather conditions
Natural disasters
Political unrest or curfews
Strikes
Epidemics or pandemics
Government restrictions
Transportation disruptions

In such situations, we will make reasonable efforts to provide suitable alternatives, reschedule services, or process refunds in accordance with our Cancellation & Refund Policy.

6.  Booking,Cancellations & Refunds
Refunds and cancellation charges will be governed by the TripNaari Booking, Cancellation & Refund Policy applicable to the booked trip.

7. Liability Limitation
TripNaari acts as a travel organiser and coordinates services provided by hotels, transport operators, activity providers, and local partners. While we carefully select our partners, we are not responsible for independent acts, omissions, accidents, injuries, loss of baggage, or personal expenses arising during the trip, except where required by applicable law.

8. Governing Law & Jurisdiction
These terms shall be governed by the laws of India. Any dispute arising in connection with TripNaari services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Bangalore, Karnataka.



Travel safe, travel confidently, and remember — we love you, Naari.
